g.text: Pooled and stage-matched calibration distances give different rankings

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #3c4b59

g.text: Means across five existing PG initializations; two CPU sampling replicates per checkpoint. All checkpoints retained.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #3c4b59

g.text: Four adaptively reused calibration donors, one per stage. Signed cross-stage terms can cancel stage-specific errors.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #3c4b59

g.text: No new training, generation, relabeling, endpoint selection or primary-metric change. No independent biological or SOTA claim.
